author: Mark Manson
description:
For most of human history, cutting off your family wasn't much of an option. Your family was your job, your safety net and your retirement plan. If you left, you were on your own in a very literal way.

That's changed. You find work through LinkedIn instead of on your dad's farm. You can rent an apartment across the country, build a friend group from scratch, and never need a relative to vouch for you.

When survival no longer depends on family, the relationship has to stand on something else. For a lot of people, that's when they find out how much was holding it together.
title: Why Cutting Off Family Is a Modern Option
